concept: IAM: SAML 2.0 IdP federation for console access
tests: How to give employees temporary AWS Console access via a corporate SAML 2.0 IdP.
expected: IAM SAML 2.0 identity provider + roles (AssumeRoleWithSAML) — SSO into the console without IAM users. Triggers: "federated access", "Management Console", "existing corporate SAML 2.0 IdP".
why_not: Cognito user pools — for application end users, not the console; IAM users break SSO; Simple AD alone does not provide SAML federation.
